label: UP modal preview: compact top pastel-UP-blue WalletConnect approval toast ("Confirm on your connected device.", Dismiss) while a WalletConnect request is pending, plus a temporary manual zero-value wallet-approval test button in Authorize (unreleased test build, not production)
notice: Preview of unreleased @lukso/up-modal and @lukso/core builds for device testing. Not an official release; the production site is unchanged.

previewOnlyChanges: @lukso/up-modal and @lukso/core from the unreleased builds below (npm override)
generated authorization links keep the base path
metadata icons keep the base path
temporary wallet-approval test button on the target step (build flag NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_WALLET_APPROVAL_TEST=true; off by default)

walletApprovalTest.shownWhen: connected through WalletConnect, on the "Search for Profile" step
walletApprovalTest.request: one eth_sendTransaction per click: from and to the connected account, value 0x0, data 0x
walletApprovalTest.instruction: Reject or cancel the request in your wallet. Approving can broadcast a zero-value transaction and spend gas.

changes: WalletConnect approval toast: while a signing or transaction request is waiting on the connected WalletConnect device, a slim pastel UP-blue strip at the top of the screen says "Confirm on your connected device." with a Dismiss control; it clears when the wallet approves or rejects (on by default; walletConnectApprovalToast: false turns it off)
compact on every screen: top max(8px, safe area), 13px text, 28px Dismiss, one line with ellipsis; very short landscape screens use a small top-left box that wraps
English copy from the Core catalog (Yata); German unchanged

kept from earlier previews: one "Log in with your Universal Profile" heading with 32px spacing, "Continue in the UP! App" first, a bottom "Get the UP! App" link, and a pending WalletConnect pairing kept alive on mobile return

build.walletConnect: up-modal default project (no project ID configured)

limitations: Not tested on a native phone or tablet with the real UP! App or third-party wallets
Not tested against the real WalletConnect relay (browser tests use a mocked WalletConnect connection and provider)
Not tested with a screen reader
The toast can cover a host page header fixed to the top of the screen (apps can turn the toast off)
Known, non-blocking: tapping a wallet again while an earlier approval is still pending does nothing until that attempt settles or the list is reopened
Known, non-blocking: tapping Wallet Connect again on a phone while an approval is pending shows a QR code instead of reopening the app
